title: 膜生物反應器整合~Membrane bioreactor integration
focus: 生物反應與膜分離的相互限制~Coupled limits of biological reaction and membrane separation
summary: MBR把生物處理與膜固液分離結合。學徒同時追蹤污泥、需氧、淨產水與膜壓差；膜能截留固體不代表所有溶解物已被破壞。~MBR couples biology with membrane solids separation. Track sludge, oxygen, net production and membrane pressure together; solids retention does not imply destruction of every dissolved substance.

units.title: 預處理後進料品質：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Post-pretreatment feed quality: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「預處理後進料品質」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at post-pretreatment feed quality.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「預處理後進料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for post-pretreatment feed quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「預處理後進料品質」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the post-pretreatment feed quality measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 高生物量負荷判讀：食微比與生物量庫存~High-biomass loading interpretation: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory
units.mechanism: 食微比比較每天有機負荷與池內生物固體庫存；BOD、COD、MLSS與MLVSS的基準不得混用。本單元在「高生物量負荷判讀」觀察此因果關係。~F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at high-biomass loading interpretation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. Formula F/M=QS/(VX); substitution 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Boundary: Nominal completely mixed ratio; nonbiodegradable fractions and temperature are excluded.
units.verify: 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「高生物量負荷判讀」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for high-biomass loading interpretation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: MLSS與活性微生物量完全等同。~MLSS is exactly equal to active microbial mass.
units.practice: 先點選「高生物量負荷判讀」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。與基準 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the high-biomass loading interpretation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Compare with baseline 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 污泥齡及排泥：污泥齡與固體流失~Solids age and wasting: Sludge age and solids losses
units.mechanism: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「污泥齡及排泥」觀察此因果關係。~SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at solids age and wasting.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
units.verify: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「污泥齡及排泥」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for solids age and wasting; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 不排剩餘污泥就代表沒有生物固體損失。~No intentional wasting means no biomass loss.
units.practice: 先點選「污泥齡及排泥」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the solids age and wasting measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 產水膜列淨通量：膜通量與有效膜面積~Membrane-train net flux: Membrane flux and effective area
units.mechanism: 膜通量是單位膜面積的產水速率；產水流量固定時，增加可用膜面積可降低通量負擔。本單元在「產水膜列淨通量」觀察此因果關係。~Membrane flux is permeate flow per area; additional available membrane area reduces flux loading at fixed production. Examine this relationship at membrane-train net flux.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：產水 Qp=96 m³/h、膜面積 A=2400 m²。公式 J=1000Qp/A；代入 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：淨產水通量；應另扣反洗停機，非任何膜產品允許值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: permeate Qp=96 m³/h and membrane area A=2400 m². Formula J=1000Qp/A; substitution 1000*96/2400 = 40 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Net production flux; backwash downtime is separate and this is not a membrane product limit.
units.verify: 以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「產水膜列淨通量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for membrane-train net flux; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 膜面積減半但產水不變時通量不變。~Flux stays unchanged when membrane area halves at constant production.
units.practice: 先點選「產水膜列淨通量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用膜面積降成1920 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 50 L/(m²·h)。與基準 40 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the membrane-train net flux measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active membrane area to1920 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 50 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 40 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 跨膜壓差趨勢：跨膜壓差與比通量~Transmembrane-pressure trend: Transmembrane pressure and permeability
units.mechanism: 相同溫度下，通量除以跨膜壓差可作為表觀水力透過率；降低代表阻力增加，但未直接指出污染種類。本單元在「跨膜壓差趨勢」觀察此因果關係。~At the same temperature, flux divided by transmembrane pressure gives apparent permeability; a decrease indicates more resistance but not its chemical cause. Examine this relationship at transmembrane-pressure trend.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：J=30 L/(m²·h)、TMP=0.15 bar。公式 Lp=J/TMP；代入 30/0.15 = 200 L/(m²·h·bar)。適用邊界：先做溫度校正；僅為操作趨勢，不是膜材本徵常數。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: J=30 L/(m²·h) and TMP=0.15 bar. Formula Lp=J/TMP; substitution 30/0.15 = 200 L/(m²·h·bar). Boundary: Apply temperature correction first; an operational trend, not an intrinsic material constant.
units.verify: 比較相同溫度與流量的前後資料，測壓點須一致。在離線場景為「跨膜壓差趨勢」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare before/after data at equal temperature and flow with identical pressure taps. Build an offline evidence table for transmembrane-pressure trend; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 堵塞與水溫下降都會降低比通量，先分離兩種原因。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Fouling and colder water both lower permeability; distinguish these causes first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 跨膜壓差越大必定代表膜更乾淨。~Higher transmembrane pressure always means a cleaner membrane.
units.practice: 先點選「跨膜壓差趨勢」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 TMP升成0.20 bar，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 L/(m²·h·bar)。與基準 200 L/(m²·h·bar)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the transmembrane-pressure trend measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only TMP to0.20 bar with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 L/(m²·h·bar). Compare with baseline 200 L/(m²·h·bar) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳：膜抽吸週期與淨產水~Backwash/relaxation net-production ledger: Membrane suction cycles and net production
units.mechanism: 膜列反洗或鬆弛時不產水，日平均通量低於抽吸期間通量；若還耗用產水反洗，需另扣反洗體積。本單元在「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」觀察此因果關係。~Backwash or relaxation interrupts production, so time-averaged flux is lower than suction-period flux; permeate used for backwash must also be deducted. Examine this relationship at backwash/relaxation net-production ledger.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：抽吸通量30 L/(m²·h)、每10分鐘抽吸8分鐘，先忽略反洗耗水。公式 Jnet=Jsuction tsuction/tcycle；代入 30*8/10 = 24 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：重複穩態週期且抽吸通量固定；不是膜產品的允許週期。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: suction flux30 L/(m²·h),8 minutes suction per10-minute cycle, initially ignoring backwash water. Formula Jnet=Jsuction tsuction/tcycle; substitution 30*8/10 = 24 L/(m²·h). Boundary: Repeated steady cycles and constant suction flux; this is not a permissible product operating cycle.
units.verify: 用產水總表核對整日淨產水，並區分反洗回流、排放及停機。在離線場景為「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile daily net permeate with a totalizer and distinguish backwash return, disposal and downtime. Build an offline evidence table for backwash/relaxation net-production ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 用抽吸瞬間通量推算全天產水會高估能力；先重建時間帳。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Extrapolating instantaneous suction flux over the full day overstates capacity; reconstruct the time ledger. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 膜停止抽吸時仍可用相同通量計入產水。~An offline suction period can be credited with the same permeate flux.
units.practice: 先點選「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把每10分鐘抽吸時間降為7分鐘，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21 L/(m²·h)。與基準 24 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the backwash/relaxation net-production ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only suction time to7 of every10 minutes with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 24 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 剩餘污泥處置：乾固體與含水率~Waste-sludge handling: Dry solids and moisture
units.mechanism: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「剩餘污泥處置」觀察此因果關係。~Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at waste-sludge handling.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
units.verify: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「剩餘污泥處置」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for waste-sludge handling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。~All wet-mass reduction during dewatering is destroyed pollution.
units.practice: 先點選「剩餘污泥處置」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the waste-sludge handling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 水質與壓差感測校驗：感測器偏移校正~Quality/pressure instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水質與壓差感測校驗」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at quality/pressure instrument checks.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水質與壓差感測校驗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for quality/pressure instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「水質與壓差感測校驗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the quality/pressure instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 離線清洗期間可用能力：備援與共同失效~Capacity during offline cleaning: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「離線清洗期間可用能力」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at capacity during offline cleaning.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「離線清洗期間可用能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for capacity during offline cleaning; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「離線清洗期間可用能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the capacity during offline cleaning measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
